Hall of Debate: If this card's ruler holds the People's Favor, their enemies **cannot** target the People's Favor. If ruled by Empire, all Imperials have this power.
Hall of Mockery: **SETUP (END) / WHEN EXPLORED:** Place [favor] [favor] [favor] [favor] on the People's Favor and move it to the shared bank—players **cannot** start with it. Burn [favor-burnt] from each favor bank.
Bandit Market: **SETUP (END) / WHEN EXPLORED:** Place [favor] on each site ruled by the bandits. _(Players may take it in Wake.)_ Burn [favor-burnt] from each favor bank.
Great Market: **SETUP (END) / WHEN EXPLORED:** Place [favor] on this site for each denizen _(including this)_ in this region. _Players may take it in Wake._
Grand Canal: Act as if this site is a Coast along with its other powers.
Blasted Pastures: **CHRONICLE (START OF THRONE):** Bury all [suit-nomad] cards on the map unless the winner rules this card.
Wild Pastures: Whenever this card's ruler would discard a [suit-beast] card from a power, they may instead pay [favor] to the [suit-beast] bank.
Desecrated Ground: If an Exile reveals a Vision while their pawn is at this site, they do not discard their current revealed Vision. _They can have any number!_
Sacred Ground: Players **cannot** play Visions, except the Conspiracy, faceup unless their pawn is at this site.
Giant's Path: [secret] **ACTION:** Move this card to another site, then place your pawn there.
Giant's Rampage: [favor] [secret] [secret] **ACTION:** Bury a denizen at any site _(even here)_. If you do, move Giant's Rampage to that site and place your pawn there.
Ruined Temple: **SETUP / WHEN EXPLORED:** If you place your pawn here, you may burn [secret-burnt]. If you do and then win the game, score double the legacy points and take rule of all bandit sites.
Temple of Ancestors: [favor] **ACTION:** Draw a card from the bottom of the world deck and play it to your advisers or discard it, as if you searched.
Broken Clock: **SETUP (END) / WHEN EXPLORED:** Advance the round marker once, if possible. _Do not roll [round-die]. This cannot end the game._
Great Clock: [favor] [secret] [secret] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Advance the round marker once, if possible. _Do not roll [round-die]. This cannot end the game._
Shattered Portal: [secret] **ACTION:** If your pawn is at this site, roll [round-die] and place your pawn that many sites Hinterward. The bottom Hinterland site wraps to the top Cradle site.
Murky Fountain: [secret] **ACTION:** If your pawn is at this site, roll 2 [defense-die] and gain Supply equal to the total [shield] rolled. If you roll none, end your Act Phase.
Hall of Ministers: Enemies of this card's ruler **cannot** discard cards from sites ruled by this card's ruler. _They can still be buried._
Bandit Patrols: Enemies of this card's ruler **cannot** recover relics at sites ruled by bandits.
Relic Patrols: Enemies of this card's ruler **cannot** recover relics at sites ruled by this card's ruler.
Lost Guardians: **SETUP (END) / WHEN EXPLORED:** Place [secret] [secret] [secret] on the Darkest Secret and move it to the shared bank. Players **cannot** start with it.
Tome Guardians: If this card's ruler holds the Darkest Secret, their enemies **cannot** target the Darkest Secret. If ruled by Empire, all Imperials have this power.
The Tribunal: **WHEN NEGOTIATING:** You may negotiate with players at any sites. Players may make binding promises, even into later games.
Bandit Tribunal: **WHEN NEGOTIATING:** Players at sites ruled by bandits may negotiate with each other.
Towering Rampart: +2 [defense-die] if your pawn is at this site or this site is targeted.
Festival District: **WHEN NEGOTIATING:** Players may give, receive, and swap advisers. _Players must follow their adviser limits._
Squalid District: [favor] [favor-burnt] **ACTION:** Discard any number of facedown advisers you have. Draw that many denizens from the bottom of the world deck as facedown advisers.
Still Boiling Lake: Cards **cannot** be played to this site. _This card can still be discarded by People's Favor, etc._
Sinking Passages: **WAKE:** If your pawn is at this site, you may burn [favor-burnt] to place your pawn on any site.
Hallowed Spring: When trading at this site for [secret], you **must** place both [favor] on the card you are trading with _(instead of burning one)_.
Ruined School: **SETUP (END) / WHEN EXPLORED:** Place [secret] on each site ruled by the bandits. _Players may take it in Wake._
Oaken Fortress: While this card's ruler is at this site, they **cannot** be targeted by a challenge or a raid campaign. If ruled by Empire, all Imperials have this power.
Rotting Fortress: Players at this site **cannot** be targeted by a challenge or a raid campaign, unless the targeting player has a [suit-beast] adviser.
Bandit Forest: Imperials **cannot** place [favor] or [secret] on cards ruled by bandits or use their non-persistent powers.
Forbidden Forest: Enemies of this card's ruler **cannot** travel to this site unless they have a [suit-beast] adviser.
Forest Horn: [secret] [secret] **ACTION:** Choose a region. Discard all non-[suit-beast] denizens at sites in that region.
